2ba042ad8a64c0aaf98f636e9c6aa4de.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Construction Projects for Regional Development Policy in Ragwon County
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 5 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction projects for the regional development policy in Ragwon County of South Hamgyong Province on July 3.
He was accompanied by leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK and the Ministry of National Defence and officials of the designing organs.

This year, modern regional-industry factories, an advanced public health facility and a multi-functional leisure complex, which will contribute to the development of the regional economy and the promotion of the inhabitants' health and their material and cultural life, are being built in Ragwon County, which is undergoing a radical change into the fairyland like its name along with the new era of regional change opened up by the Party, under the third year's plan for implementing the regional development policy.

The construction of regional-industry factories, hospital and leisure complex in Ragwon County is now progressing at 67.5 percent, 47 percent and 54 percent of the total construction projects respectively, thanks to the soldier-builders who are leaving traces of worthwhile creation and feats day by day to uphold the cherished desire of the Party Central Committee with honorable fruits of patriotic devotion and efforts.
First, Comrade Kim Jong Un gave field guidance at the construction sites of regional-industry factories in Sepho-ri, Ragwon County.

He was greeted on the spot by Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, and commanding officers of the construction units involved in the construction projects for the regional development policy in Ragwon County.
He went round foodstuff factory, daily necessities factory and garment factory under construction to learn in detail about the construction.

Praising the fact that the quality of construction for all the architectural spaces and elements is being ensured on a high level, he said with great satisfaction that the specialization and technical equipment level of construction units have been certainly improved to a higher stage as compared with last year and the environment around the construction site arranged in a clean way.

Saying that the construction quality and speed have been improved in the overall construction projects for the regional development policy as a result of the sustained efforts made to increase the proportion of mechanization in construction and strengthen the ranks of skilled workers, Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed the need to continue to reinforce construction equipment and, at the same time, make effective judgment on technical skill rating for the builders and properly evaluate according to them.

Enjoying a bird's-eye view of the area of Sepho-ri showing the traction and vitality of the Party's regional development policy, he said with pleasure that this was a shabby place when he made up his mind to build the Ragwon County Offshore Farm but there sprang up an advanced offshore farm and an ideal modern fishing village. He added that the construction of modern regional-industry factories and a greenhouse farm is turning the area into an industrial zone.

Acquainting himself with the operation of the offshore farm in the county, he said that since a good asset has been provided to lay foundations for the improved material and cultural life of its residents and independent economic development, the County Party Committee and the County People's Committee should hold fast to the main link and carry out all the tasks in a responsible manner and thus turn the county into a place with its own characteristics as a coastal area good to live in while creating and leading the civilization in the new era. He advanced detailed tasks and ways to do so.

He also called for making the struggle for the implementation of the Party's regional development policy an important political occasion cultivating the working spirit and voluntary revolutionary consciousness of all the residents who are determined to carve out their future by themselves.
He went round the hospital and leisure complex being built in the township of Ragwon County.

Learning about the construction, he highly praised the soldier-builders for thoroughly ensuring the quality of construction, aware that every structure will be associated with the leadership feats of our Party and conscience of the service personnel.

Although structures have the same purposes, their characteristics as the mountainous, coastal and flat areas have to be preserved and new things applied steadily and they should be harmonized with surrounding natural landscape, he said, adding that this is an important requirement of the Party's regional construction policy. And he stressed that the whole construction sector should have a proper understanding of this and create a new standard and a new record every year and steadily renew them.

Since new hospitals, leisure complexes and regional-industry factories have to be built in 20 cities and counties every year, it is needed to supply sufficient material and technical means for designing and building and steadily develop the builders' activeness and creativeness so that all the structures can be successfully built to fully embody the Party's idea on architectural aesthetics and meet the architectural engineering requirements, he said.

Saying that the important significance of construction work is being more highlighted in bringing all-people struggle for the overall development of socialism to a steady upsurge at present, he expressed his idea to further accelerate the regional transformation by expanding and deepening the regional development policy in a gigantic way in the future.

The epoch-making changes in local areas at which even we admire are historic miracles that can be created only by our army, he said, adding that the entire Party, the whole country and all the people should give full play to the spirit of assisting the army with sincerity.

He called upon construction units at all levels to put constant efforts into the political and ideological education so as to firmly prepare all the soldier-builders to be staunch defenders and implementers of the Party's policies and make them fully display their excellent political awareness and morality and patriotism in the fields of socialist construction.

He clarified the important tasks arising in the completion of the construction and the operation of objects, including the issue of strictly meeting the requirements of the method of construction at the finishing work and intensifying supervision, the issue of conducting the designs for afforestation well and giving precedence to the afforestation and greening in time, the issue of building up the county's own construction forces and directing primary efforts to improving urban management including the provision of domestic water for inhabitants and the removing of sewage, the issue of preparing the ranks of medical workers to run modern hospitals without any deviation, the issue of taking responsible measures for the supply of raw materials to regional-industry factories and the issue of paying deeper attention to the living conditions of soldier-builders.

He expressed expectation and belief that all the soldier-builders involved in the construction projects for the regional development policy would invariably remain faithful to their honorable duty and vanguard role, with the awareness that they are the core and engine leading the comprehensive development of socialism, and thus glorify the first year of implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK as a year of proud victory in which regional areas are making another leap forward in their transformation.

Encouraged by the field guidance and the greatest trust of Comrade Kim Jong Un, all the soldier-builders pledged to uphold the Party's policy on regional development with high results at the level required by the new era of comprehensive development. -0-

bb19ffa3f70af886c200730609764324.title: Destroyer Kang Kon Has Performance Test of Its Weapon Systems
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 5 (KCNA) -- The destroyer Kang Kon on Friday conducted a test-fire of strategic cruise missile and a test of major weapon systems such as naval artillery, automatic machine guns and electronic warfare means under its plan to assess and test the performance of its combat systems.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the tests.

Among the spectators were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, and Kim Kwang Il, minister of Shipbuilding, and other leading officials in the field of national defence and shipbuilding industries.
The relevant tests are part of a process for examining and confirming the ability to apply various kinds of weapon systems on board the destroyer in combat.

Prior to the tests, Comrade Kim Jong Un heard from members of the weapon systems assessment group detailed reports on the stepwise plan to examine and test the performance of weapon systems on board the warship.

Then there took place the inspection of the warship's target-detecting and information-processing capability and combined firepower system and the test-fires aimed to assess the performance of warship artillery and automatic machine guns in accordance with the plan to assess and test the performance of weapon systems.
They were followed by the launch of a strategic cruise missile from the destroyer.

Noting that the combat power and creditability of anti-warship, anti-submarine and anti-aircraft weapon systems and strategic offensive weapon systems on board the destroyer Kang Kon are being verified in a responsible manner, Comrade Kim Jong Un said that it is enough to have confidence in potential for the development of naval combat system of our own style in view of the recent trend of development of our weapon systems and this provides the great possibility to bring on a change in the readiness posture of our army's strategic action.

He clarified the tasks to be carried out by stages in developing various surface and underwater combat systems and deploying them in the waters for military action under the crucial strategic idea of our Party for national defence.

Noting that it is necessary for us to further speed up the projects to maintain and steadily expand the reliable war deterrent and capability to fight a war, he affirmed that we will demonstrate through more obvious actions our political will and determination to have an absolute power.

Recalling the fact that the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK adopted a decision to build naval fleet bases into a hub of naval command, culture and combat capability and expand the capacity of the shipyards at all levels, he expressed his determination to take national steps to build up our Navy which plays an important role in defending the maritime sovereignty of the country and exercising the war deterrent.

He encouraged the warship and weapon system institutes to achieve greater success in their efforts to implement the Party Central Committee's idea and line of building a powerful army, deeply mindful of their historic mission.
He gave an instruction to complete the trial process of the destroyer in a responsible manner and commission it for the Navy within two months.
That day he convened an important consultative meeting for the development of the warship building industry. -0-

0d6dcdf6c950dd638461eab4b4f90f28.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun on Greatest Memorial Day of Our Party, State and People
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the 32nd anniversary of demise of the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung, all the people and service personnel of the DPRK are filled with boundless yearning and reverence for him, the peerlessly great sage who built our Party and state into the genuine Party and country for the people and laid the eternal foundation of Korean-style socialism winning victories with independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defence, regarding it as his lifelong motto to believe in the people as in Heaven and build a rich country with a strong army.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun at 00:00 on July 8, the greatest memorial day of our Party, state and people.

Accompanying him were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party and the government, officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, commissions and ministries, and commanding officers of the armed forces organs.
Flower baskets were laid at the statues of the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung and the great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il.
Comrade Kim Jong Un, together with the participants, paid high tribute to the statues.
At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, Comrade Kim Jong Un made deep bows to them, praying for their immortality.

All the participants hardened their solemn will to more resolutely and courageously work in the vanguard of the gigantic struggle for transformation in the new era for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung and for the eternal dignity and glory of our Party, state and people. -0-

ae6848777fd2ed4ab81c3830fc7fbb53.title: First Enlarged Meeting of Ninth WPK Central Military Commission Held
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The First Enlarged Meeting of the Ninth Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea was held on July 9.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, Chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the meeting.

Present there were members of the WPK Central Military Commission and, as observers, major commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, military and political commanding officers of the large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army and officials of relevant departments of the WPK Central Committee.

The meeting discussed important political and military tasks for bolstering up the politico-ideological and military technical might of the People's Army and bringing about a qualitative change in strengthening the combat readiness of the army units at all levels since the strategic orientation, goals and policies for building the armed forces to reflect the present military and political situation and the requirements of the times were set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK and the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK.

Saying that the prestige, honor and destiny of socialist Korea are unthinkable apart from the powerful defence capabilities, Comrade Kim Jong Un stated that the security and peace of the country and the people can not be defended with the willingness alone and that only when we build the strong army and control all and contain threats with its powerful strength, is it possible to achieve the true peace.

The People's Army should invariably play a leading and core role not only in defending socialism but also in the struggle for comprehensive development of the state, he stressed, saying that the far-reaching plan and confidence in the future struggle are based on the absolute trust in our army.

He declared that it is our Party's steadfast policy on building a powerful army to turn the People's Army into a strong army united as one in mind sharing the ideas and intention with the Party Central Committee and to develop it into invincible armed forces by steadily strengthening its politico-ideological mightiness and spiritual-moral superiority and military technical superiority.
Stressing the need to thoroughly put the People's Army on a field warfare and modern basis and enhance its actual war capability, he advanced the important tasks facing the army units at all levels.

The meeting decided on the issue for upgrading the technical infrastructure of combat systems, bolstering up the nuclear force both in quality and quantity and pushing ahead with the plan for standardizing, specializing and modernizing military bases in a far-sighted way. And it confirmed the specific orientation and ways for bringing about a substantial change in training sector and putting spurs to the revolution in military education.

The meeting suggested tasks and ways for expanding in a many-sided way the functions and missions of the General Reconnaissance and Intelligence Bureau, which plays a pivotal role in controlling the potential enemies' threats and gathering key information, and enhancing its capability of military reconnaissance and intelligence activities in a radical way.

The meeting also confirmed the direction of activities of the People's Army and its detailed tasks to accelerate the construction of modern naval bases and the technical updating for expanding the capacity of shipyards at all levels in keeping with the start of signal transformation in our Navy's position and role and to accomplish the great historic cause for completely remodeling the coal-mining areas across the country. And it discussed a structural measure for implementing them and a proposal for mobilizing troops.

Saying it is the greatest trust and honor given by the times and the revolution to the People's Army that it is entrusted with the important projects, decisive of the state development and existence, Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed that the whole army should be inspired to turn out in proving once again before history that it is the trait and fighting mettle peculiar to our army to make greater and more vigorous stride of loyalty and feats as the struggle front becomes wider and larger.
Comrade Kim Jong Un signed seven written orders on the important military measures, discussed and decided at the Party Central Military Commission.
The meeting conveyed the directive of the WPK Central Military Commission on the immediate military structural measure.
The meeting dealt with the organizational matter of dismissing, transferring and newly appointing leading officers for key posts of the People's Army.

The important military measures, discussed and decided at the First Enlarged Meeting of the Ninth Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea, serve as a significant practical step for giving great impetus to the struggle for implementing the WPK's line of building a powerful army on turning the DPRK's armed forces into the strongest one in the world and remarkably enhancing the combat power, activity and leading role of our army in defending socialism and in all spheres of socialist construction. -0-

50a22e58fe28ab7b036b9f952986291c.title: Let Us Guarantee Victorious Advance of Revolution by Strong and Sound Order and Strict Legal Discipline Report on Joint Meeting of Party, Government and Army of DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK are carrying out the most righteous mission and great historic cause, taking full responsibility for the destiny and future of the people. Their prestige and mightiness are based on the strict national law and strong and sound discipline system.

The Ninth Congress of the WPK put forward it as the foremost requirement of the times to ensure the complete unity of action and establish the strong discipline in socialist construction as a whole. And the state law of the DPRK is directing the spearhead of resolute struggle against the acts of exercising privilege, abusing power and resorting to illegalities and corruption which destroy the basis of the Korean revolution and erode socialist state system.

A joint meeting of the Party, the government and the army took place in Pyongyang on July 10 to give a warning to all sorts of anti-revolutionary, anti-socialist, anti-people acts going against the trend of the times when the whole Party and the entire people are going all out for implementing the decisions of the Party congress, and signify the intensified high-intensity struggle.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the joint meeting.

Present at the meeting were senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, commanding officers of the Korean People's Army units at all levels, leading officials of the ministries, national agencies, Party and power organs and major industrial establishments and officials in the discipline inspection sector and law enforcement organs.

Put on the agenda at the meeting was the issue of drawing a serious lesson from the crimes committed by corrupt elements in the political organ of the People's Army who were engrossed in high-profile irregularities and corruption.

The joint meeting informed the participants of the data exposing high-profile irregularities and corruption committed by Pak Hui Chol, former vice-director in charge of organizational affairs of the General Political Bureau of the People's Army, and his followers.
The Central Military Commission of the WPK took a measure in late June to bring a charge of irregularities and corruption against Pak Hui Chol and investigate him.
Pursuant to the measure, the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK decided to dismiss him from the Party central leadership body and refer him to a law enforcement organ.

The highest law enforcement organ of the DPRK examined the crimes of the accused, who engaged in acquiring ill-gotten wealth by various means while holding an important post in the political organ of the People's Army, and accomplices who catered to his heinous irregularities and corruption.
All the crimes committed by the accused were clearly proved by objective evidence at the trial.

The accused Pak Hui Chol committed scandals and illegally acquired wealth by abusing his power of arranging organizational work and appointing cadres, seriously betraying the trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee and the people and challenging the Party's line of strengthening discipline. He exerted a very harmful influence on strengthening the ranks of cadres of the People's Army in a qualitative way, enhancing its fighting efficiency and establishing sound military traits by receiving a large amount of bribes and leading a dissipated life.

During the past four years when he had been in a responsible post of the political organ, he created special illusions about him while being engrossed in all sorts of abuses of authority and arbitrariness, and received a large amount of bribes from dishonest elements obsessed with greed and thirst for a high post.

He fostered the acts of buying and selling posts, receiving bribes and committing political fraud in the army and seriously hindered the establishment of the Party's monolithic command system across the entire army by appointing his confidants and toadies to important posts.

He neglected every affair related with the implementation of the Party's command policy across the entire army by plundering the maximum amount of state funds, materials and dwelling houses and squandering them in dissolute and depraved life.
Pak Hui Chol's scandals are extra-large crimes that go beyond imagination in view of their dangerousness and harmfulness.

As a result of the strict struggle against scandal, our army came to be provided with a powerful motive force capable of removing the poison and evil practices lurking inside the military and political guidance organ at the right time and further renewing its militant prestige.

Through the serious political struggle, the People's Army has made a stride forward in making the entire army ideologically elite. The reality proved that the further the struggle against scandals is intensified, the stronger the army becomes, the cleaner its purity becomes and the deeper the trust of the Party and the people in the heroic strong army becomes.

The participants in the meeting realized once again the necessity and urgency of observing the strict political and moral discipline and intensifying the uncompromising struggle, which have defended the qualitative growth and firm union of the revolutionary ranks, in the present important historical course.
A verdict on the accused was issued.
The Supreme Court of the DPRK sharply condemned extra-large scandal corrupt elements for their crimes and imposed penalties on them.
Comrade Kim Jong Un made an important concluding speech.

The essence of the recent case lies in the fact that the person in a responsible position, who has heavy duty and authority to contain, detect and eradicate such an act as illicit accumulation of wealth so despised by the Party and the people, abused the authority as a weapon for his own interests and emerged as the chief culprit of irregularities and corruption, Comrade Kim Jong Un said, stating that this is a political crime against the Party's line of building discipline and a deliberate act of embezzlement and plunder against the interests of the state and the people.

Seriously pointing to the gravity of this high-profile corruption that occurred when our Party declared an all-out war against the abuse of power, bureaucratism and irregularities and corruption and has steadily enhanced the intensity of the struggle, he cautioned the discipline inspection units at all levels.

Saying it is a lesson taught by the recent case that if we fail to steadily intensify education and control to prevent the officials from getting contaminated with irregularities and corruption and abandoning Party principles, it is impossible to prevent such wrongdoings, he stressed that all the officials should keep principle and uprightness as their lifeblood and should be mindful of the Party's trust and think of the people first.

Comrade Kim Jong Un clarified the solemn stand of the Party Central Committee to steadily enhance the intensity of the organizational and ideological offensive for transforming the ranks of cadres into an elite and the legal struggle for rooting out irregularities and corruption.

The joint meeting strongly signaled that there is no place for irregularities and corruption harmful to the developing revolution and the elements infected by them to exist. And it re-expressed the unshakable will of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to proactively and positively suppress and repel all sorts of corruption and violations of discipline and thus open up a new phase of building a ruling party, strong and sound in discipline and full of a vital revolutionary climate, and dynamically accelerate the building of a powerful nation under the strict legal discipline. -0-

f50ce6b9a764f56ba8c8af49c341587a.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Chinese Party and Government Delegation
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Thursday received a party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China led by Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Communist Party of China and chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, on an official goodwill visit to the DPRK to mark the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
Present there was Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK.
Comrade Kim Jong Un gladly met and exchanged warm greetings with Wang Huning and leading members of the delegation.

Wang Huning courteously conveyed the best wishes and comradely greetings from Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the PRC, to Comrade Kim Jong Un.
Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed deep thanks for it and asked Wang Huning to convey his greetings to Comrade Xi Jinping.

Warmly welcoming the visit of the party and government delegation of the PRC to the DPRK, Comrade Kim Jong Un said with high appreciation that it is a manifestation of the steadfast will to attach importance to the DPRK-China relations and definitely implement the agreements made during the Pyongyang summit that Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping dispatched the high-ranking party and government delegation headed by Wang Huning to the DPRK.

Noting that the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, an inter-state treaty which defines the strategic character of the bilateral relations and advances its strategic direction, has played an important role in defending the basic interests of the two countries and ensuring the regional and global peace and security, Comrade Kim Jong Un said that it is the steadfast policy of the WPK and the DPRK government to more vigorously develop the traditional friendly and cooperative relations with socialism as a core in several fields on the basis of the spirit of the treaty and in line with the requirement of the changing times and the aspiration and desire of the two peoples.

Expressing thanks to the Party, government and people of the DPRK for giving the delegation a cordial reception, Wang Huning expressed the readiness to comprehensively implement all the important common understanding and agreements the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries reached in the historic Pyongyang meeting and thus promote the political mutual trust and bilateral solidarity and expand and develop the mutual collaboration and cooperation.

Comrade Kim Jong Un affirmed that the WPK and the DPRK government would as ever support the socialist cause with the Chinese characteristics in the new era led by Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping, sincerely hoping that the Chinese people, who significantly celebrated the 105th anniversary of the foundation of the CPC, would make greater achievements in the historic course of comprehensively building a modern socialist power and achieving the great prosperity of the Chinese nation under the leadership of the CPC. -0-

1f10a577759a50d1af3c1bd9c9718e49.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Exemplary Officers and Men of Construction and Engineering Unit
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with exemplary officers and men of a construction and engineering unit, who are performing brilliant feats of labour at major worksites for socialist construction, on July 17.

The officers and men of the unit were overflowing with the great excitement and joy as they would greet the moment of glory they always desired and awaited in the honorable days when they were building structures and dwellings symbolic of the great era of transformation.
When Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue for the photo session, they broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"

Acknowledging the enthusiastically cheering crowd, he extended warm militant encouragement to the service personnel who are displaying the unconditional execution spirit and implacable power of execution in carrying out our Party's order.

He expressed the belief that all the officers and men of the unit would continue making remarkable achievements, the desires of the country and the people, in the vanguard of construction revolution for building structures of eternal value this year, too. And he had a photo taken with them.

They hardened their iron will to keep in mind Comrade Kim Jong Un's great trust in them and continue performing brilliant construction miracles and thus make a tangible contribution to the prosperity of the country. -0-

4326293a72f36e93aecd33a5bad2c02b.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets and Has Photo Session with Participants in Eighth SWUK Congress
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met with the participants in the Eighth Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea on July 17.

The venue for the photo session was overflowing with the great excitement and joy of women's union officials and members who were waiting for the moment of glory and happiness, their earnest desire, after attending the significant congress held amid the great interest and congratulation of all other people of the country.

When Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the tender-hearted father who put forward our women before the era and has shown them great trust and love.
An official of the women's union respectfully presented a bouquet of fragrant flowers to him, representing boundless reverence and best wishes for him.
Comrade Kim Jong Un congratulated the newly elected chairwoman and vice-chairwomen of the Eighth Central Committee of the SWUK, shaking hands with them.

He extended warm greetings of encouragement to the participants, who displayed through the largest-ever gathering in the history of the women's union the noble loyalty, preeminent revolutionary spirit, inexhaustible might of unity and patriotic enthusiasm of the Korean women unconditionally supporting what the Party is determined to do and faithfully carrying it out and successfully completed the work of the congress.

The past five years which have passed along with the great pioneering period of comprehensive rejuvenation are clearly associated with the devoted efforts of our strongest, steadfast, diligent and resourceful women who dynamically accelerated the advance of the country, he said, adding that the role of the women's union as educator and organizer and mobilizer obviously proved that when the women unite with a single will and intention and pool their wisdom, strength and enthusiasm, they can surmount any difficulties and realize any ideals.

It is our Party's highest pride and our state's great strength to have the women's organization full of the noble spirit of firmly trusting and following our Party only and passionately loving and defending socialism, a powerful group of women patriots without a parallel in their active role and fighting efficiency, he noted.

Our Party's great historic cause will be successfully accomplished and our state's dignity and might more fully demonstrated as our women are adding to beauty and freshness of their families and the society and giving steady continuity to the generation of patriotism and revolution with the noble viewpoint on life intended to place the duty to repay above the right to enjoy and feel a sense of pride of genuine life and joy on the road of patriotism and with the genuine maternal affection, he stressed

The gigantic struggle for transformation in the new era highlights the need to further strengthen the women's union in charge of a part of the revolution, he said, stating that the women's union organizations at all levels should first of all concentrate on the ideological education so as to firmly maintain the revolutionary nature, pure mind and beauty of our women who regard the Party's lines and policies as their faith and advance along only the road indicated by the Party.

He expressed the expectation and belief that all the women's union officials and members would always keep in mind their missions and duties they assumed before the era and the revolution, their families and society and become genuine patriots making a tangible contribution to the prosperity of the country always with a single mind and intention, and communist mothers and educators bringing their children up to be fine ones. And then he had a photo taken with them.

After the photo session, the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers, expressing their faith and will to firmly unite under the banner of the WPK and greet all happiness and glory under its loving care.
Comrade Kim Jong Un waved back to and extended warm encouragement to the participants who were raising stormy cheers in expression of their ardent loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm.

All the participants hardened their iron will to fully display with redoubled self-confidence and exertion the fighting efficiency of the women's union in the worthwhile struggle for the prosperity of our great state and the happiness and bright future of the rising generations. -0-

620c7e1e1815e48d438a6f5c3eb8432a.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Cemetery of CPV Fallen Soldiers on Occasion of 73rd Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Cemetery of the Fallen Soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Hoechang County of South Phyongan Province on July 26 on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and paid high tribute to the fallen soldiers.

He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Kim Song Nam and Ju Chang Il, secretaries of the C.C., WPK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence, and Pak Jong Chon, adviser to the Ministry of National Defence.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the cemetery.
The national anthems of the People's Republic of China and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played.
A wreath in the name of Comrade Kim Jong Un was laid at the cemetery.
Comrade Kim Jong Un paid a silent tribute to the memory of the fallen soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers.
Then he visited the grave of Mao Anying at the cemetery. He placed a flower at the grave and paid homage.

The ennobling soul and self-sacrificing spirit of the brave CPV soldiers, who shed their blood to assist the DPRK people in the war of justice in the most difficult and fateful years, are clearly associated with the victory won by the DPRK people and they are shining as the foundation for the DPRK-China friendship with socialism as its core.

The DPRK people will never forget the merits and heroic feats of the excellent sons and daughters of the Chinese people who unsparingly dedicated their hot blood and precious lives, fighting shoulder to shoulder with our army and people in the same trench of the unprecedented death-defying struggle for repelling the imperialists' invasion. -0-

84598b85c98ee8d1f9907f3bfbc9db63.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Occasion of V-Day
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel of the Korean People's Army in the DPRK significantly celebrate July 27, a symbol of heroism and invincibility of the DPRK, paying high tribute to the honorable first defenders of the state and creators of the precious tradition of victory shining as the gold star of immortality along with the honor of the great victor nation.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on July 26 on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the war victory.
Comrade Kim Jong Un gladly met with war veterans and warmly wished them good health and long life.

Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, war veterans, persons of wartime merits, bereaved families of war martyrs, students of revolutionary schools and Pyongyangites.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the cemetery.

Comrade Kim Jong Un placed a flower at the memorial "Soul of Heroes" and paid high tribute, praying for immortality of the martyrs who recorded the first page of the defence of the country, adding majestic shine to the dignity of heroic Korea with their precious blood in the first period of the foundation of the state.
A gun salute was fired in memory of the Fatherland Liberation War martyrs.
Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the cemetery.

He said that although many years have passed since the ceasefire of the war, the great victory won by the young DPRK in the cradle to devotedly defend not only the dignity and sovereignty of the state but also the global peace and security in a heavy and hot war against the U.S. imperialists, the chieftain of imperialism, and their followers is shining as the most eye-opening and signal victory and eternal biography of heroes unprecedented in the human history of wars.

He stressed that the miracle of July 27 won by the ordinary army and people on this land with ardent love and indomitable might should be the precious ideological and moral wealth and infinite latent energy of the Korean revolution to be invariably and thoroughly carried forward regardless of the replacement of generations and the growing gains of the revolution in the long journey of building a power.

He affirmed that our cause of building a rich country with a strong army would emerge victorious when we always remember the worthwhile spirit of self-respect, matchless stubbornness and noble self-sacrificing spirit displayed by the wartime generation who pioneered the heroic history of the Republic with their blood and remain faithful to their intention and will.
The participants laid flowers at the graves of the martyrs, recalling the brilliant names and images and heroic lives of the martyrs and praying for their immortality.
Fireworks were displayed in the sky of July as a manifestation of respects to the immortal and legendary feats of the sung and unsung war martyrs.

The heroic merits of the participants in the Fatherland Liberation War and their immortal exploits, recorded in the revolutionary history of our people with the brilliant gold letters, will be handed down to posterity. -0-

876cbefbfb0c6bb7c99c3277a7177005.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong to Mark 73rd Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on July 26 to mark the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War.

Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
The KPA guard of honor lined up at the cemetery.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
A wreath bearing the august name of Comrade Kim Jong Un was placed at the wreath-laying stand amid the playing of the wreath-laying music.
Wreaths in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK were laid at the cemetery.

Comrade Kim Jong Un, together with all the participants, paid a silent tribute to the memory of the revolutionary martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the sacred cause for the independence and sovereignty of the country and the defence of its sovereignty and the people's wellbeing and happiness.
There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor.

Comrade Kim Jong Un placed flowers before the busts of Kim Chaek, Kang Kon and Choe Hyon on Jujak Peak who made a distinguished contribution to the war victory, with deep reverence for the revolutionaries of the first generation who created and glorified the ever-victorious tradition and history, fighting in the bloody anti-Japanese war and the flames of the Fatherland Liberation War under the leadership of President Kim Il Sung.

He said that the fighters' absolute loyalty to the leader, spirit of devotedly implementing the revolutionary tasks and courageous will without impossibility were developed into the ideological and moral qualities of the defenders of the country in the 1950s and this was the basic foundation that made the victorious wartime generation the most heroic generation of the DPRK and the model of the indomitable Korean people.

He affirmed that the glory of July 27 would continue with greater and more dynamic victory in the course of advance of our cause sacred with great pioneering and succession and that our country associated with the patriotic soul of the forerunners would be prosperous forever as a powerful socialist state.

He paid high tribute to the revolutionary martyrs who created the precious revolutionary spirit and tradition to be handed down to posterity and laid the eternal foundation for the national prosperity, praying for their immortality as a model of brilliant life and struggle for all the successive generations of the DPRK and a mainstay of their firm faith. -0-

94f1d4107157b2f5ebc8d68731beb847.title: Art Performance Marks 73rd Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) --The honourable memory of July 27, the Day of Victory that enabled our great motherland to enjoy the everlasting dignity and fame as a strong power, and the heroic spirit of the victorious wartime generation serve as a precious ideological and mental nutrient and cornerstone of victory which dynamically encourage our people and the service personnel of the People's Army to accomplish the great historic cause of building a rich country with a strong army.

A splendid art performance was given to mark the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War in the capital city of Pyongyang on July 27 when the whole country was overflowing with the respect for the heroic defenders of the motherland in wartime and the great honour and self-confidence of the successors who are firmly preserving and glorifying the high honour of war victory and opening up the wonderful era of transformation for the prosperity of the country.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, appreciated the art performance together with war veterans and persons of wartime merits invited to the celebrations of the Day of Victory.
When Comrade Kim Jong Un appeared in the auditorium, the audience raised stormy cheers of "hurrah!"

The performers and audience paid the highest tribute to Comrade Kim Jong Un, the symbol of the mightiness of our Party, state and people and banner of all the victories and glory, raising enthusiastic cheers.

Comrade Kim Jong Un extended congratulations to the war veterans, the persons of wartime merits and all the people across the country and officers and men of the whole army who are significantly celebrating the holiday of great war victory.
He met with war veterans and sincerely wished them long life in good health.
Lovely children presented bouquets of fragrant flowers to Comrade Kim Jong Un and war veterans.

Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of ministries and national agencies, service personnel of the People's Army, officials and lecturers engaged in the administration of revolutionary relics associated with the victorious war, Pyongyang citizens including descendants of war heroes, students of revolutionary schools and other youth and students.
Diplomatic envoys of the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation staying in the DPRK were invited.

The art performance began with preludes "July 27, Our Victory Day" and "July 27 March", adding to the excitement of the meaningful Day of Victory that made the audience recall the ever-victorious history of our glorious Republic and convinced them of the greater victory in the future. Put on the stage were wartime songs and others in praise of war victory resounded in the annals of succession.

The performers warmly congratulated war veterans and persons of wartime merits, the first generation defenders of the motherland who created the great history of war victory of our state, representing the unanimous desire of all the people across the country.
Children's Union members and boys and girls presented bouquets to war veterans and persons of wartime merits.

The performers sang in an excited tone wartime songs in high praise of the spirit of defending the country and revolution displayed by the wartime generation who bravely fought in the fierce war to safeguard the sovereignty and honour of the motherland with the transparent revolutionary faith that the motherland is just the embrace of President Kim Il Sung and they are sure to win when they absolutely believe in and follow him. The audience were filled with great emotion as the songs made them respectfully recollect the legendary annals.

Song "Red Blossom" newly composed on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of war victory was an eruption of the warmest respect of our people for the wartime generation who defended the sacred sovereign right and beautiful future with infinite loyalty to the Party and revolution and ardent patriotism and created the indomitable and heroic spirit, a motive force of sure victory.

The audience were deeply touched by videos showing the matchless self-sacrificing spirit, heroism and brilliant feats of excellent sons and daughters of the Chinese people who shared life and death, fighting shoulder to shoulder with our people in the same trench of the struggle of repelling the invasion of the imperialists, and Chinese songs such as "Battle Song of Chinese People's Volunteers".

The performers artistically and superbly depicted the DPRK people's eternal thanks to the brave fighters of the Chinese People's Volunteers, who assisted our people in their sacred and righteous war under the uplifted banner of resisting America and aiding Korea even in the difficult days of building the country and made an important contribution to the war victory and the defence of global peace and security, and the truth that the DPRK-China friendship based on the shared ideal and militant fraternity will be immortal along with the history of the great war victory.

Watching documentaries on the three years of war which imposed miserable misfortune and pains on our people filled with the delight of greeting the liberation and joy over new life, terrible disasters in rigorous 1129 days and lessons of history they should never forget, the audience bore in mind as their strong will the important sense of duty of our generation to adorn with the greater victory the glory and honour of our state the defenders of the motherland in the 1950s achieved at the cost of their blood and reliably hand them down to the next generation.

The art performance was acclaimed by the audience as it helped them have a firmer conviction that as long as the noble spirit and soul, sources of winning war victory, are alive, and the new generation faithful to the intention march on proudly, victory belongs to the DPRK forever.
At the end of the art performance, war veterans and persons of wartime merits gave bouquets to performers.

Through the art performance, the successors further hardened their faith and will to firmly defend and carry forward our ideology and system, precious tradition of victory the first defenders of the Republic safeguarded at the cost of their blood and glorify the DPRK, our beloved motherland, as the more powerful and endlessly prospering socialist power. -0-

f9d0f97996c438ef859734327fe47bce.title: Ceremonial Parade of Columns Symbolic of Units Fought in Fatherland Liberation War Marks 73rd Anniversary of Its Victory
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- The whole country is overflowing with joy and excitement of greeting the great holiday of war victory with the high pride of winning new victories of great importance to glorify the immortal honour and dignity of the heroic Korea, which the first defenders of the Republic imposingly raised as a great power in an eastern part of the earth, and heroic people.

A ceremonial parade of the columns symbolic of the units that fought in the Fatherland Liberation War was held in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on the evening of July 27 to mark the 73rd anniversary of war victory, unfolding historic scenes demonstrating the tradition of victory which has been firmly carried forward as the bloodline of the Korean revolution and the indomitable heroic spirit which has been displayed to the full century after century.

The plaza before the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium and its surroundings were crowded with citizens who gathered with the great pride of celebrating the unprecedented legendary victory won by the two-year-old state, a new-born country in a cradle, and the two-year-old army which fought against the imperialist allied forces to defend the inviolable sovereignty and prevent the ravages of a new world war.

To the tune of the vibrant song of the revolutionary army, the columns of paraders in military uniforms like the ones the soldiers wore during the war, and with rifles in their hands which vividly show the traces of hand-to-hand fight entered the plaza.

Prior to the parade, a combined military band depicted the heroic course of Juche Korea which has firmly defended and added luster to the glory of July 27 through colorful formation changes and light rhythmic movements.

When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, appeared on the platform, the participants broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" and gorgeous fireworks were displayed in the sky over the capital city.
Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly acknowledged the enthusiastically cheering participants.

Leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and the commanders of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army took their seats on the platform together with war veterans.
Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys of the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation staying in the DPRK.

Seen in the auditorium were war veterans, persons of wartime merits, officials of the Party Central Committee, senior officials of ministries and national institutions, service personnel of the People's Army, officials and lecturers engaged in the administration of revolutionary relics associated with the victorious war, Pyongyang citizens including descendants of war heroes, students of revolutionary schools and other youth and students.
No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defense of the DPRK, made a speech.

Saying that the celebrations of the Day of Victory reaches the climax with tonight's ceremonial parade arranged to keep the memory of and pride in the past history and incite the complete succession to the great tradition and the declaration of a fresh victory, the speaker noted that today's march of the columns represents the heroic advance during the days in the flames of fierce battles and vividly shows the tradition of victory running through the past annals.

The victorious wartime generation are still standing before us as an exemplar of the persons leading a patriotic life with the motherland and a respectful teacher encouraging the descendants to engage in the heroic struggle and perform feats by exciting their mental world, he said, adding that we will forever thank and respect the great generation who won the most disastrous war to ensure the most beautiful future and made this country strong by devoting their passionate youth and all their valuable things.

The speaker noted that our army will as ever open up in the van the unprecedented era of a power with transparent faith and through the unexampled struggle, stressing that the successors will continue to march forward year after year with the indomitable heroism, displayed by the defenders of the motherland in the 1950s in their struggle, and the mission of the class and their grandiose advance and courageous spirit immortalize the honour of our state.

All the paraders burst into cheers of "hurrah!" in expression of their militant enthusiasm for determinedly making strides to inherit the honour of war victory achieved at the dear cost and winning a greater victory in the van of the gigantic struggle to build a prosperous and powerful country.
Then there was a review of the preparations for the parade.
KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon reviewed the columns of the parade units.
He courteously reported to Comrade Kim Jong Un on the completion of the preparations for the parade.
The commander of the parade gave the order to start the ceremonial parade.

The column symbolic of the bodyguard company marched at the head of the parade units, holding high the ennobling image of General Kim Il Sung, the iron-willed commander in those days over 70 years ago. It eloquently proved what is the source of all victories of the great Korean revolution and where is the irresistible might of our ever-victorious army.

And shining like a group of loyal stars in the column were the portraits of the first generation bodyguards of our army who became a bulletproof wall to defend the supreme headquarters in the hard-fought and fateful years with a firm faith that it is possible to ensure the war victory, destiny of the motherland and happiness and future of the people when they defend the leader at the cost of their lives.

The columns symbolic of the legendary guards divisions entered the plaza, flying high their glorious colours which demonstrate their military exploits of annihilating the U.S. imperialists' ill-famed "undefeated divisions", "elite divisions" in the three years of the fierce war when the soldiers had to step on empty cartridges more than the soil on mountains and killed more enemies with bayonets than they did with rifles.

Among them were the columns symbolic of the Kang Kon Guards 2nd Infantry Division, the Seoul Kim Chaek Guards 4th Infantry Division and other units bearing the names of anti-Japanese generals, fighters who rendered distinguished services in founding the army and performed indelible exploits in the great history of war victory. The paraders marched, holding high portraits of the commanding officers of anti-Japanese guerrilla background who implemented the operational plans of the leader with absolute faith and distinguished military qualifications.

The spectators paid high tribute to the greatest loyalists and heroes as they set the living example of genuine loyalty to President Kim Il Sung, who led Korea to victory with his unique military ideas and strategy and tactics hard to find in any other military theories in the world, which should be regarded by all the generations of the Republic as a textbook.

The columns marched in fine array, making the spectators recall numerous legendary feats performed in the operation of liberating Seoul, a world-startling miracle created in 72 hours, the operation of liberating Taejon, a brilliant example of a contemporary battle of encirclement, the battle for defending Height 1211, a trap valley which heralded the destruction of the enemies, and others during the Fatherland Liberation War.

Fireworks were displayed as a sign of victory and celebration to wonderfully decorate the nocturnal sky of the Day of Victory. And the columns symbolic of the Guards Second Torpedo Boat Squadron and the Guards 56th Hero Kim Ji Sang Pursuit Plane Regiment marched past the plaza. They were telling about the feats performed by the heroic seamen, who created the miracle of Jumunjin and the myth on Wolmi Islet to be specially recorded in the world history of naval battles, and the pilots who became human bombs to reduce the air superiority of the U.S. imperialists to the leaves falling in the autumn wind.

Comrade Kim Jong Un sent warm greetings to the columns dynamically passing through the plaza, flying the flag of the Guards associated with the heroic fighting spirit, matchless bravery and spirit of annihilating the enemy of the victorious wartime generation.

The portraits of the immortal fighters, who annihilated the invaders with the love for their native home and parents and siblings and the hatred of the enemies and became human bombs to destroy the enemies' pillboxes and tanks while crying for "long live the leader" as they are the generation deeply moved by benevolence shown by the leader who put forward them as the master of the country, factory and land, were seen in the columns symbolic of the guard regiments.

Among the columns were those of the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Railways which produced known or unknown heroes who fought for war victory on the front or in the rear during the three-year war.
The foot columns were followed by those of combined mechanized carriages and motorcycles, symbols of the mechanized units engaged in the Fatherland Liberation War.

The columns made the participants recollect the merits of the victors in the great years who proved the truth that if the ideas and tactics are great, it is possible to defeat any formidable enemy with inferior arms, by winning the most brilliant victory despite the most rigorous ordeals.

The plaza was full of reverence for the masters of the heroic times who made a legendary history of resistance at the cost of their warm blood, firmly cemented the foundations of the Republic with the victory they won at the cost of their lives and opened up the rosy future of the Korean revolution.

Appeared at the plaza were the columns of the three services of the Korean People's Army, demonstrating the features of the dignified revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK which incomparably became strong.

Sky-high was the spirit of the guards of the new generation who firmly defend the inviolable territorial lands, waters and air of our state with absolute defence capability while steadily and invariably inheriting the tradition of loyalty, patriotism and victory created in the flames of the war and adding luster to the history of Juche Korea wining victory after victory.

Comrade Kim Jong Un extended warm militant encouragement to the invincible elite ranks and representatives of the matchless army who newly defined the concept of the strong army and the law of victory and placed the absolute might of the revolutionary armed forces at the peak of honour with loyalty to the Party and the country, ardent patriotism, mass heroism and indomitable fighting spirit peculiar to the army.

The paraders marched past the plaza with the firm pledge to charge absolute weaponry, the strongest in the world, with the revolutionary idea of the Workers' Party of Korea and fully display the honour of our generation with the miraculous merits and fresh legendary about victory surpassing heroism displayed in the annals of history.
At the end of the parade, the stormy cheers of excitement were broken and fireworks displayed in the nocturnal sky to commemorate the V-Day.
Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering masses.

The parade fully demonstrated once again the firm faith and fighting spirit of the generation of successors to add great victories to the immortal feats of the victorious wartime generation under the leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un, the banner of all victories, and usher in the era of building a prosperous power unprecedented in history. -0-

d4c1eff8abe8a174157e176b311b305d.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets and Has Photo Taken with War Veterans and Persons of Wartime Merits
paragraphs: Pyongyang, July 29 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met war veterans and persons of wartime merits, who took part in the celebrations of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, and shared warm feelings with them on July 28.

War veterans and persons of wartime merits were filled with boundless emotion and joy as they were honoured to be present at the moment of happiness and glory they had wished even in their dreams after taking part in the splendid celebrations of the Day of Victory in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK.

When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un appeared, all the participants paid their sincere respects and gratitude to the most brilliant commander and great father who has been glorifying the tradition of July 27, the Day of Victory, and heroic spirit, both of which symbolize the immortal honour of the DPRK, century after century and inspiringly ushering in a new era of building a rich country with a strong army for which all the generations of this land are yearning.

Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to war veterans and persons of wartime merits, the defenders who wrote the first page in the history of the great power at the cost of their blood and the benefactors who provided the spiritual mainstay of our country which will be powerful forever.

He said that the annual events arranged to splendidly mark July 27, the Day of Victory, together with the wartime generation serve as a significant occasion of instilling into the hearts of the descendants the spirit of self-respect which was fully displayed in the heroic annals and the truth of sure victory which can never be bartered for anything, and those aimed to encourage the struggle for winning new victories.

It is a great pleasure of and encouragement to our Party, state and people that the victorious wartime generation, who demonstrated to the world the heroic position and reputation of our country which should be glorified through generations, are standing before us as the personifier and witness of miraculous victory, he noted.

He had a photo to be recorded forever in the history of succession taken with war veterans and persons of wartime merits, expressing his firm will to reliably carry forward the great and excellent features and the myth of the most righteous power created amidst the gunfire of the hard-fought war in 1950s as the lineage of the ever-victorious Korean revolution, and thus powerfully hasten the building of the prosperous power that the heroic wartime generation envisioned.

Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly shook hands with the participants who were trying to be the first to meet him with their eyes in tears of emotion and repeatedly hoped that precious war veterans and persons of wartime merits, who play the role of the inexhaustible strength and spiritual mainstay that nobody can perform in their place even today when their hair turned gray, would be full of energy despite their advanced age. -0-
